description: This file defines data structures and a singleton class for managing instances' presence information in a macOS application. It handles fetching, updating, and notifying about instances' presence state, including local fallback data, health probing, and real-time event handling.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and updating the list of active instances, handling real-time presence events, fetch health status, and notifying app components about state changes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins periodic refresh and presence event subscription, unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing refresh and event subscription tasks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches current presence data from the control channel and updates the instances list accordingly.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates a fallback InstanceInfo representing the local machine's node status.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events related to presence updates and snapshots.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes raw presence data and applies it to update the state.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and processes presence event payloads received from the push stream.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts raw presence entries into standardized InstanceInfo objects.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates the internal presence list and triggers notifications for node connections.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends user notifications when new nodes connect.
